about: 20 short made-up Singapore-style lines from KakiGuard (a teammate's NCS Hackathon 2026 project, server/seed.js), reused with her permission. 10 are community reports (all scams), 10 are quiz cards (7 scams, 3 normal). A different person wrote them, so they were an independent check of our rules, until we used them to add rules (13 to 16 Nov 2026). type is her category mapped to ours (bank and gov -> impersonation, delivery -> parcel, ecommerce -> phishing, other 'Hi Mum' -> impersonation); null for quiz cards, which have no category.
